subject.title: Agents page: dropdown selector causes too much friction, should show agent list directly

question: Should the Agents page replace the desktop dropdown-first selector with a visible agent list/sidebar, keep the dropdown, or adopt another navigation pattern?
rationale: Current main still has the dropdown-first UI, while the proof-supplied visible-list PR was closed unmerged; automation should not choose the permanent Control UI layout without maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt a desktop visible list
options.body: Land or replace the prior visible-list implementation with responsive desktop rows/sidebar and mobile dropdown fallback.

options.title: Keep dropdown-first navigation
options.body: Close the remaining UX request as not planned after documenting that the dropdown is the intended Agents page pattern.

options.title: Request a different design
options.body: Keep the issue open for a maintainer-specified layout direction such as a denser sidebar, table, or hybrid selector.

recommendation.title: Adopt a desktop visible list
recommendation.body: Land or replace the prior visible-list implementation with responsive desktop rows/sidebar and mobile dropdown fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main rehomed UI files blame to steipete, and the choice is a Control UI product/design decision rather than a narrow code defect.
